title: Copy, then compare: w=w
notes: Tape 2 gets a $ in its first cell and then a copy of 0110. The head on tape 2 rewinds to the $, and the two heads compare the copy with the word after the = in one pass. 16 moves for 9 symbols: linear. One tape needs about n² moves for the same language.
ops: mark 0|1|=,_ -> copy -,$ S,R; copy 0,_ -> copy 0,0 R,R; copy 1,_ -> copy 1,1 R,R; copy =,_ -> back S,L; back =,0|1 -> back S,L; back =,$ -> check R,R; check 0,0 -> check R,R; check 1,1 -> check R,R; check _,_ -> accept S,S
